name: Purple Moonlight
source:
Purple Moonlight is a game about bartending. Uncle David always says that there are two absolutes that bartenders follow: One, always keep calm and cool, as bartenders, you need to create an atmosphere for guests to be able to relax and enjoy their drinks. Secondly, well, just don't screw up the order.

The game is planned to be created to play as a bartender mixing drinks and serving it to the customers. Learn their life and hear their problems. Get acquainted and get closer to them. Purple Moonlight offers a tale of love, adventure, sex and many more.

[From [url=https://mangograhamqueen.itch.io/purple-moonlight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Purple Moonlight》是一款关于调酒的游戏。大卫叔叔总说，调酒师必须遵守两条铁律。第一，始终沉着冷静。作为调酒师，你得营造一种氛围，让客人能放松下来，好好享受杯中的酒。第二嘛，别把点单搞错就行。

本作计划让玩家扮演调酒师，为客人调制并奉上饮品。了解他们的生活，倾听他们的烦恼，逐渐熟悉，拉近彼此的距离。《Purple Moonlight》将带来一个包含爱情、冒险、性爱，以及更多内容的故事。

[摘自[url=https://mangograhamqueen.itch.io/purple-moonlight]itch.io[/url]]
